F5GuardrailsRailConfig.description:
Configuration for the F5 Guardrails integration.

Note: The API key is intentionally not part of this config. It is a secret
and must be provided via the F5_GUARDRAILS_API_KEY environment variable.

api_url.description: Base URL for the F5 Guardrails API.
api_url.title: Api Url

fail_open.description: If True, allow content through when the F5 Guardrails API is unreachable or returns an error. This changes the security posture of the rail and should be reviewed as part of the guardrails config.
fail_open.title: Fail Open

max_retries.description: Number of additional attempts after receiving HTTP 429 from the F5 Guardrails API. Total attempts equal max_retries + 1. Set to 0 to disable rate-limit retries.
max_retries.title: Max Retries

max_retry_after_seconds.description: Upper bound (in seconds) on how long to honor a Retry-After header returned by the F5 Guardrails API. Larger values are clamped to this cap to prevent unbounded waits.
max_retry_after_seconds.title: Max Retry After Seconds

retry_backoff_seconds.description: Base delay (in seconds) used with exponential backoff when a 429 response has no usable Retry-After header. The delay for attempt N (zero-indexed) is retry_backoff_seconds * 2**N, still clamped to max_retry_after_seconds.
retry_backoff_seconds.title: Retry Backoff Seconds
